notes.title: Animality - Mini Games Update
notes.notes:
Animality now has 2 mini games that are available, you can play 


Animality Arabian Derby:

Cost to play: 100 Coins
Victory Coins: 300 Coins

Select an animal or demon and they will race against each other, if your animal wins then you will be rewarded with 300 coins


Animality Duck Hunt:

Cost to play: 50 Coins
Victory Coins: 250 Coins

Try to find 3 ducks amongst the 500 rampaging creatures, find all 3 and be awarded with 250 coins
